시편-20-1.title: 시편 20장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-20-1.exegesis: 12-14. The clearer our view of the law, the more manifest are our sins. Still for its full effect we need divine grace to show us our faults, acquit us, restrain us from the practice, and free us from the power, of sin. Thus only can our conduct be blameless, and our words and thoughts acceptable to God.

시편-20-2.title: 시편 20장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-20-2.exegesis: PSALM 20 Psa 20:1-9 . David probably composed this Psalm to express the prayers of the pious for his success as at once the head of the Church and nation. Like other compositions of which David in such relations is the subject, its sentiments have a permanent value--the prosperity of Christ's kingdom being involved, as well as typified, in that of Israel and its king. 1. hear thee-- graciously ( Psa 4:1 ). name of-- or manifested perfections, as power, wisdom, &c. defend thee-- set thee on high from danger ( Psa 9:9 ; 18:3 ).

시편-20-3.title: 시편 20장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-20-3.exegesis: 2. strengthen thee-- sustain in conflict; even physical benefits may be included, as courage for war, &c., as such may proceed from a sense of divine favor, secured in the use of spiritual privileges.

시편-20-4.title: 시편 20장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-20-4.exegesis: 3. all thy offerings-- or gifts, vegetable offerings. accept-- literally, "turn to ashes" (compare 1Ki 18:38 ). Selah-- (See on Psa 3:2 ).
시편-20-4.theologicalNote: 3. all thy offerings-- or gifts, vegetable offerings. accept-- literally, "turn to ashes" (compare 1Ki 18:38 ). Selah-- (See on Psa 3:2 ).

시편-20-6.title: 시편 20장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-20-6.exegesis: 5. salvation-- that wrought and experienced by him. set up our banners-- ( Nu 2:3 , 10 ). In usual sense, or, as some render, "may we be made great."

시편-20-7.title: 시편 20장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-20-7.exegesis: 6. He speaks as if suddenly assured of a hearing. his anointed-- not only David personally, but as the specially appointed head of His Church. his holy heaven-- or, literally, "the heavens of His holiness," where He resides ( Psa 2:6 ; 11:4 ). saving ... hand-- His power which brings salvation.

시편-20-8.exegesis: 7. remember-- or cause to remember, mention thankfully ( 1Sa 17:45 ; Psa 33:16 ).

시편-20-9.title: 시편 20장 9절 역사문법적 주해
